title: 서비스 점검의 기술 연결 흐름

description: React requests Express. Express invokes the MCP Client and Server in the same Node.js process. MCP tools query the Node.js HTTP sample service and PGlite directly. The HTTP sample reads production records from PGlite. Express also persists incident, run and guide records in PGlite. Dashed edges represent the optional OpenAI API analysis and server-mediated execution of model-selected MCP tools; no direct model-to-MCP connection or verified external model call is implied.
